svg.title: Geometric design: anchor dots and guides
svg.text: Geometric design: anchor dots and guides
Left half: trace the gray design. Right half: only the anchor dots; join them with short strokes to mirror it. Lesson 07.2.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Gray dots: anchor points. Dashed lines: level guides. Red dotted ovals: the eye area, keep lines and color out of it.
Join dot to dot with short strokes, each about a third of a side. Turn the page so you always pull toward yourself.
